fixed.explanation: Tracing._captureSnapshot awaits snapshotter.captureSnapshot, which evaluates in the page's main thread, without honoring the progress timeout. A blocked page therefore hangs forever. Wrapping the call in progress.race makes the timeout apply.

query.intent: Tracing snapshotter captures a DOM snapshot before/after each API call by evaluating a script in the page (snapshotter.captureSnapshot / tracing.onBeforeCall). This awaits the page's main thread without honoring the call's progress/timeout, so a blocked page hangs. Make the snapshot step abort on progress timeout, or run it racing against the timeout.
query.symptom: With tracing snapshots enabled, API calls on a page with a blocked main thread hang forever and ignore their timeout.
